paragraphs: Weeds growing from a crack in a flowerpot.
Things growing here and there—or things that are dying.
A white cicada, newly shed of its shell.
An alley where the light falls beautifully.
Changhwa on the way to meet someone he loves.
A child practicing on the playground.
Following white paint scattered along the road…
This story follows the memory held in a single roll—a record of Yongsan-gu in the summer of 2026.
